verdict.rationale: RUN's own docs say it can pay employees who work in more than one state or local jurisdiction in the same pay period, calculate, file and pay payroll taxes, and manage state unemployment insurance. That covers multi-state payroll and per-state tax handling, but nothing documents state tax registration, and per-state withholding logic is only implied by the tax-calculation claims. Missing for 10: documented state tax account registration, explicit per-state withholding configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-state accuracy.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run payroll for employees across multiple states with the right registrations and withholdings per state

citations.quote: Easily pay employees who work in more than one state or local jurisdiction in the same pay period — and we’ll handle the tax filing for you.
have payroll taxes calculated, filed and paid for you
Complete management of your state unemployment insurance, including reviewing your account for erroneous charges and auditing your SUI experience rate(s)
